verdict.rationale: Gram is an AI control plane and MCP gateway. A platform of that kind could plausibly ship scheduled or triggered background agent runs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes automations, schedules, triggers or autonomous background execution: the closest feature is an in-dashboard agent harness for testing MCP servers interactively, and deployment or monitoring commands are unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
